summary: A controller, MIDI router and four-track arranger firmware built on CTL-1, playing patterns, songs and albums through MIDI or the built-in General MIDI synth. Beta.
features: Four arranger tracks with PATTERN, SONG and ALBUM playback
Up to 512 pattern IDs in a dedicated music area
LIVE PLAY: keys pick 176 patterns, queued to the loop end
Knobs set the four track volumes in LIVE PLAY
USB MIDI device or host, Bluetooth MIDI and TRS MIDI
On-device Sonivox General MIDI sound engine

headings: live play: keyboard as a pattern selector
